name: @qf-jarvis/aarohi-agent
description: QF Jarvis Aarohi AVG-1 prospect identity and acquisition-case DOMAIN (ADR-0085, QVGE overlay). Aarohi's runtime remains PLANNED / DISABLED: no runtime, no outreach, no channel, no credential, no provider, no n8n, no Instagram, no WhatsApp, no persistence, no Core mutation and no execution of any kind. Pure contracts and pure functions over frozen values. Depends on zod.
